scope: Local disposable PostgreSQL/Redis integration and unit/socket checks; production acceptance not run

checks: Different hosts can open rooms together; concurrent retries of one create request return one room
Concurrent distinct creates leave one open room per host; stale retries and another account cannot replace it
Failed replacement insert rolls back old-room closure in the real database
Guest resume preserves one membership; normalized nickname collision and unrelated reads are rejected
Server sampling is unique and balanced, excludes audio, and rejects insufficient stock
Config resets all ready states; stale ready and a disconnected roster cannot Start; countdown hides content
Late arrivals spectate; concurrent spectator admission respects five slots; unfinished results remain private
Active projection hides keys, explanations, furigana, opponent choices and active-round points
The last roster answer opens reveal without waiting for the maximum deadline
Account export includes completed offline schedules, rebuilds own score and excludes active matches, keys and other players
Read recovers finalization; completed review is scoped; spectator can opt in; rematch preserves code and old result URL
Cleanup preserves active matches and unexpired results; expired guest identity is anonymized without deleting score ledgers
Replacing an active room closes old clients, rejects new joins/answers, preserves completed history and leaves the other host untouched
Real Redis Lua: authenticated takeover is immediate; old owner cannot renew or release replacement
Concurrent Start: one match and one frozen roster
Private ACK; first answer final; concurrent retry creates one answer; other player can answer
Spectator and expired guest cannot submit; Unicode nickname keys fit normalization
Database clock is read after lock wait; late acceptance is rejected
Concurrent/repeated finalization is idempotent; late identical retry preserves original ACK
SQL rejects a second running match, cross-match answers, and missing identity
RLS enabled on all six tables; all three Data API roles denied access
Real account anonymization removes identity and host access while preserving opponent ledger

covers: independent create buckets for accounts sharing an IP
rejected/stale requests do not publish closures
closed room snapshot terminates its socket

limitations: Production browser and cross-deployment multiroom acceptance not run
Provider free tier budget/capacity is not established by removing the application cap
Existing AWS SDK Node 20 support notice during build
